announcements.headline: 3rd Quarter Results
announcements.insight: As a pure-play on China's renewable energy transition, SDIC Power's Q3 results provide critical visibility into the profitability pressures from curtailment and grid integration costs within the sector. The market will scrutinize these figures for signs of margin stabilization amidst intense competition in wind and solar development.
